title: Deuce Point
intro: A point lasts about six seconds. Then you get about twenty-five before the next one, and every other game there's a ninety second changeover. This session squeezes that shape down: six sprints, a long breather, six more. The twenty-fourth effort is the one that matters. Each game is its own card.

Ten metres out and ten back, as fast as you can control, with one hard turn at the far end. Twenty-five seconds between sprints and ninety between games, so time the ninety on a watch. That twenty-five seconds is the session, so don't stretch it. You need twenty metres of flat, dry ground with real grip, a few metres clear at each end, and tape or a line marking the far end. Wear court shoes or trainers with grip, and skip wet grass and polished floors. Padel points run longer, so padel players run the out and back twice, about twelve seconds, once the normal version feels easy to control.

before.label: Not today
before.text: A sore ankle, knee, calf, hamstring, groin or Achilles, or an injury in the last month? Get it looked at first.

before.label: Stop and get it checked
before.text: A sharp pain, pain that spreads, numbness, swelling, a joint that gives way, or a sudden pull or pop.

before.label: Stop now
before.text: Chest pain, dizziness, a heartbeat that races or skips, or breathing that doesn't feel right. Get it looked at before you train again. Told to be careful with hard exercise? Check with your doctor first.

before.label: A day or two later
before.text: Far more sore than normal, or your pee goes dark? Get it checked the same day.

before.label: Keep clear
before.text: 48 hours clear of a match, heavy lower-body lifting, Hard Stop and Cut & Recover in the On-Court list, and any other hard running session, on either side. Leave it out of a tournament week.

before.label: First time
before.text: Run the first game at about three quarters speed and stop after two games.

exercises.name: Build-Up Run
exercises.note: Easy to fast. Run the last two as ten metres out, a turn at about three quarters speed and ten metres back.

exercises.name: Shuttle Sprint
exercises.note: Game 1 of 4: if your turns get sloppy, a foot slips, something twinges or your sprints slow right down, stop after this game and go to the cool-down.

exercises.name: Shuttle Sprint
exercises.note: Game 2 of 4: walk and breathe for ninety seconds first, and go to the cool-down instead if the last game got sloppy, twinged or slowed right down.
